```diff
+ /**
+  * 创建ai_roles表（如果不存在）

+ async function createAIRolesTable(): Promise&lt;void&gt; {
+   console.log(&#39;📋 检查并创建 ai_roles 表...&#39;);
+   
+   try {
+     // 检查表是否存在
+     const checkTableSql = &#96;
+       SELECT name FROM sqlite_master 
+       WHERE type=&#39;table&#39; AND name=&#39;ai_roles&#39;
+     &#96;;
+     const tableExists = await db.query(checkTableSql);
+     
+     if (tableExists.length &gt; 0) {
+       console.log(&#39;✅ ai_roles 表已存在&#39;);
+       return;
+     }
+     
+     console.log(&#39;⚠️  ai_roles 表不存在，正在创建...&#39;);
+     
+     // 读取并执行创建表的SQL
+     const sqlPath = join(__dirname, &#39;create-ai-role-tables.sql&#39;);
+     const sql = readFileSync(sqlPath, &#39;utf-8&#39;);
+     
+     const statements = sql
+       .split(&#39;;&#39;)
+       .map(s =&gt; s.trim())
+       .filter(s =&gt; s.length &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; !s.startsWith(&#39;--&#39;));
+     
+     for (const statement of statements) {
+       if (statement.trim()) {
+         try {
+           await db.query(statement);
+         } catch (error: any) {
+           // 忽略已存在的错误
+           if (!error?.message?.includes(&#39;already exists&#39;) &amp;&amp; 
+               !error?.message?.includes(&#39;duplicate&#39;)) {
+             throw error;
+           }
+         }
+       }
+     }
+     
+     console.log(&#39;✅ ai_roles 表创建成功&#39;);
+   } catch (error) {
+     console.error(&#39;❌ 创建 ai_roles 表失败:&#39;, error);
+     throw error;
+   }
+ }
+ 
+ /**
+  * 插入或更新AI角色
+  */
+ async function upsertAIRole(
+   role: IndependentPageRole | SmartWorkflowRole,
+   source: &#39;independent-page&#39; | &#39;smart-workflow&#39;,
+   connectionType: &#39;chatflow&#39; | &#39;workflow&#39; = &#39;chatflow&#39;
+ ): Promise&lt;void&gt; {
+   try {
+     // 检查角色是否已存在
+     const checkSql = &#39;SELECT id FROM ai_roles WHERE id = ?&#39;;
+     const existing = await db.query(checkSql, [role.id]);
+     
+     // 准备Dify配置
+     const difyConfig = {
+       apiUrl: DIFY_API_BASE_URL,
+       apiKey: role.apiKey,
+       connectionType: connectionType,
+     };
+     
+     if (existing.length &gt; 0) {
+       // 更新现有角色
+       const updateSql = &#96;
+         UPDATE ai_roles 
+         SET name = ?, 
+             description = ?, 
+             dify_config = ?,
+             enabled = 1,
+             updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
+         WHERE id = ?
+       &#96;;
+       
+       await db.query(updateSql, [
+         role.name,
+         role.description,
+         JSON.stringify(difyConfig),
+         role.id,
+       ]);
+       
+       console.log(&#96;🔄 更新角色: ${role.name} (${role.id})&#96;);
+     } else {
+       // 插入新角色
+       const insertSql = &#96;
+         INSERT INTO ai_roles (
+           id, name, description, avatar, system_prompt, dify_config, enabled, source,
+           created_at, updated_at
+         ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
+       &#96;;
+       
+       await db.query(insertSql, [
+         role.id,
+         role.name,
+         role.description,
+         null, // avatar
+         null, // system_prompt
+         JSON.stringify(difyConfig),
+         1, // enabled
+         source,
+       ]);
+       
+       console.log(&#96;✅ 创建角色: ${role.name} (${role.id})&#96;);
+     }
+   } catch (error) {
+     console.error(&#96;❌ 处理角色 ${role.name} (${role.id}) 失败:&#96;, error);
+     throw error;
+   }
+ }
+ 
+ /**
+  * 初始化所有AI角色配置
+  */
+ async function initializeAIRoles(): Promise&lt;void&gt; {
+   console.log(&#39;🚀 开始初始化AI角色配置...&#39;);
+   console.log(&#96;📍 Dify API Base URL: ${DIFY_API_BASE_URL}&#96;);
+   
+   try {
+     // 1. 创建表
+     await createAIRolesTable();
+     
+     // 2. 初始化独立页面角色
+     console.log(&#39;\n📝 初始化独立页面AI角色...&#39;);
+     for (const role of INDEPENDENT_PAGE_ROLES) {
+       await upsertAIRole(role, &#39;independent-page&#39;, &#39;chatflow&#39;);
+     }
+     
+     // 3. 初始化智能工作流角色（可选）
+     console.log(&#39;\n📝 初始化智能工作流AI角色...&#39;);
+     for (const role of SMART_WORKFLOW_ROLES) {
+       await upsertAIRole(role, &#39;smart-workflow&#39;, role.connectionType);
+     }
+     
+     console.log(&#39;\n🎉 AI角色配置初始化完成！&#39;);
+     
+   } catch (error) {
+     console.error(&#39;❌ 初始化失败:&#39;, error);
+     throw error;
+   }
+ }
+ 
+ /**
+  * 显示当前AI角色列表
+  */
+ async function displayAIRoles(): Promise&lt;void&gt; {
+   try {
+     const listSql = &#96;
+       SELECT id, name, source, enabled, 
+              json_extract(dify_config, &#39;$.apiKey&#39;) as api_key,
+              created_at
+       FROM ai_roles 
+       ORDER BY source, name
+     &#96;;
+     const roles = await db.query(listSql);
+     
+     if (roles.length === 0) {
+       console.log(&#39;\n⚠️  当前数据库中没有AI角色配置&#39;);
+       return;
+     }
+     
+     console.log(&#39;\n📋 当前数据库中的AI角色配置:&#39;);
+     console.table(roles.map((r: any) =&gt; ({
+       ID: r.id,
+       名称: r.name,
+       来源: r.source,
+       启用: r.enabled === 1 ? &#39;是&#39; : &#39;否&#39;,
+       API Key: r.api_key ? r.api_key.substring(0, 20) + &#39;...&#39; : &#39;N/A&#39;,
+       创建时间: r.created_at,
+     })));
+   } catch (error) {
+     console.error(&#39;❌ 查询AI角色失败:&#39;, error);
+   }

+     // 初始化AI角色

+     
+     // 显示结果

+     
+     console.log(&#39;\n✨ 迁移脚本执行完成！&#39;);
+

+     await db.close();
```

## AI配置迁移完成总结

### 迁移结果

- 已创建 `ai_roles` 表（包含索引和触发器）
- 已迁移 10 个 AI 角色配置到数据库

### 迁移的配置详情

1. 独立页面角色（5个）：
   - AI问答 (`independent-page-ai-search`)
   - 技术包装 (`independent-page-tech-package`)
   - 技术策略 (`independent-page-tech-strategy`)
   - 技术通稿 (`independent-page-core-draft`)
   - 发布会演讲稿 (`independent-page-speech`)

2. 智能工作流角色（5个）：
   - 智能工作流-AI问答 (`smart-workflow-ai-search`)
   - 智能工作流-技术包装 (`smart-workflow-tech-package`)
   - 智能工作流-技术策略 (`smart-workflow-tech-strategy`)
   - 智能工作流-技术通稿 (`smart-workflow-core-draft`)
   - 智能工作流-发布会演讲稿 (`smart-workflow-speech`)

### 创建的迁移脚本

- 脚本路径：`backend/src/scripts/migrate-ai-configs.ts`
- 功能：
  - 自动创建 `ai_roles` 表（如果不存在）
  - 插入或更新所有默认 AI 角色配置
  - 支持重复运行（已存在的配置会被更新）
  - 显示迁移后的配置列表

### 再次运行迁移脚本

如果需要重新迁移或更新配置，可以运行：

```bash
cd backend
export SQLITE_DB_PATH=./data/database.db
npx ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register src/scripts/migrate-ai-configs.ts
```

### 验证数据

可以通过以下命令验证数据库中的配置：

```bash
sqlite3 backend/data/database.db "SELECT id, name, source, enabled FROM ai_roles ORDER BY source, name;"
```

```diff
+     console.log(&#39;&#39;);
+ 
+     await db.connect();
+     console.log(&#39;✅ 数据库连接成功\n&#39;);
+ 
+     // 1. 获取所有数据库表
+     const dbTables = await getDatabaseTables();
+     console.log(&#96;📊 数据库中的表（共 ${dbTables.length} 个）：&#96;);
+     dbTables.forEach(table =&gt; console.log(&#96;   - ${table}&#96;));
+     console.log(&#39;&#39;);
+ 
+     // 2. 检查每个表的记录数
+     console.log(&#39;📈 表记录统计：&#39;);
+     const tableStats: Array&lt;{ name: string; count: number }&gt; = [];
+     for (const table of dbTables) {
+       const count = await getTableRecordCount(table);
+       if (count &gt;= 0) {
+         tableStats.push({ name: table, count });
+         console.log(&#96;   - ${table}: ${count} 条记录&#96;);
+       }
+     }
+     console.log(&#39;&#39;);
+ 
+     // 3. 检查模型对应的表
+     console.log(&#39;🔍 模型与表对应关系：&#39;);
+     const modelChecks: Array&lt;{ model: string; table: string; exists: boolean; count: number }&gt; = [];
+     
+     for (const [model, table] of Object.entries(MODEL_TABLE_MAPPING)) {
+       const exists = dbTables.includes(table);
+       const count = exists ? await getTableRecordCount(table) : -1;
+       modelChecks.push({ model, table, exists, count });
+       
+       if (exists) {
+         console.log(&#96;   ✅ ${model} -&gt; ${table} (${count} 条记录)&#96;);
+       } else {
+         console.log(&#96;   ❌ ${model} -&gt; ${table} (表不存在)&#96;);
+       }
+     }
+     console.log(&#39;&#39;);
+ 
+     // 4. 检查服务对应的表
+     console.log(&#39;🛠️  服务与表对应关系：&#39;);
+     for (const [service, tables] of Object.entries(SERVICE_TABLE_MAPPING)) {
+       console.log(&#96;   ${service}:&#96;);
+       for (const table of tables) {
+         const exists = dbTables.includes(table);
+         const count = exists ? await getTableRecordCount(table) : -1;
+         if (exists) {
+           console.log(&#96;     ✅ ${table} (${count} 条记录)&#96;);
+         } else {
+           console.log(&#96;     ❌ ${table} (表不存在)&#96;);
+         }
+       }
+     }
+     console.log(&#39;&#39;);
+ 
+     // 5. 检查未使用的表
+     console.log(&#39;🔎 数据库中未映射的表：&#39;);
+     const mappedTables = new Set([
+       ...Object.values(MODEL_TABLE_MAPPING),
+       ...Object.values(SERVICE_TABLE_MAPPING).flat(),
+     ]);
+     
+     const unmappedTables = dbTables.filter(table =&gt; !mappedTables.has(table));
+     if (unmappedTables.length === 0) {
+       console.log(&#39;   ✅ 所有表都有对应的模型或服务&#39;);
+     } else {
+       unmappedTables.forEach(table =&gt; {
+         const count = await getTableRecordCount(table);
+         console.log(&#96;   ⚠️  ${table} (${count} 条记录) - 未找到对应的模型或服务&#96;);
+       });
+     }
+     console.log(&#39;&#39;);
+ 
+     // 6. 检查缺失的表
+     console.log(&#39;⚠️  模型中定义但数据库中不存在的表：&#39;);
+     const missingTables: string[] = [];
+     for (const [model, table] of Object.entries(MODEL_TABLE_MAPPING)) {
+       if (!dbTables.includes(table)) {
+         missingTables.push(table);
+         console.log(&#96;   ❌ ${model} -&gt; ${table} (表不存在)&#96;);
+       }
+     }
+     
+     if (missingTables.length === 0) {
+       console.log(&#39;   ✅ 所有模型对应的表都存在&#39;);
+     }
+     console.log(&#39;&#39;);
+ 
+     // 7. 生成总结报告
+     console.log(&#39;═══════════════════════════════════════════&#39;);
+     console.log(&#39;   检查总结&#39;);
+     console.log(&#39;═══════════════════════════════════════════&#39;);
+     console.log(&#96;总表数: ${dbTables.length}&#96;);
+     console.log(&#96;已映射的表: ${dbTables.filter(t =&gt; mappedTables.has(t)).length}&#96;);
+     console.log(&#96;未映射的表: ${unmappedTables.length}&#96;);
+     console.log(&#96;缺失的表: ${missingTables.length}&#96;);
+     console.log(&#39;&#39;);
+ 
+     // 8. 生成详细报告
+     const report = {
+       timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
+       database: &#39;./data/todify2.db&#39;,
+       totalTables: dbTables.length,
+       tables: tableStats,
+       models: modelChecks,
+       unmappedTables,
+       missingTables,
+     };
+ 
+     console.log(&#39;📄 详细报告已生成（见下方 JSON）\n&#39;);
+     console.log(JSON.stringify(report, null, 2));
+ 
+   } catch (error) {
+     console.error(&#39;❌ 检查失败:&#39;, error);
+     throw error;
+   } finally {
+     await db.close();
+   }
+ }
+ 
+ // 如果直接运行此脚本
+ if (require.main === module) {
+   checkDatabaseServiceMapping()
+     .then(() =&gt; {
+       console.log(&#39;\n✨ 检查完成！&#39;);
+       process.exit(0);
+     })
+     .catch((error) =&gt; {
+       console.error(&#39;\n❌ 检查失败:&#39;, error);
+       process.exit(1);
+     });
+ }
+ 
+ export { checkDatabaseServiceMapping };
+ 
```

</details>

```diff
+ /**
+  * 创建缺失的数据库表
+  * 为当前数据库中缺失的表创建表结构
+  */
+ 
+ import { DatabaseManager } from &#39;../config/database&#39;;
+ import { readFileSync } from &#39;fs&#39;;
+ import { join } from &#39;path&#39;;
+ 
+ const db = new DatabaseManager();
+ 
+ /**
+  * 检查表是否存在
+  */
+ async function tableExists(tableName: string): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {
+   try {
+     await db.connect();
+     const result = await db.query(&#96;
+       SELECT name FROM sqlite_master 
+       WHERE type=&#39;table&#39; AND name = ?
+     &#96;, [tableName]);
+     return Array.isArray(result) &amp;&amp; result.length &gt; 0;
+   } catch (error) {
+     return false;
+   }
+ }
+ 
+ /**
+  * 执行SQL语句（支持多语句）
+  */
+ async function executeSQL(sql: string): Promise&lt;void&gt; {
+   const statements = sql
+     .split(&#39;;&#39;)
+     .map(s =&gt; s.trim())
+     .filter(s =&gt; s.length &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; !s.startsWith(&#39;--&#39;));
+ 
+   for (const statement of statements) {
+     if (statement.trim()) {
+       try {
+         await db.query(statement);
+       } catch (error: any) {
+         // 忽略表已存在的错误
+         if (!error?.message?.includes(&#39;already exists&#39;) &amp;&amp; 
+             !error?.message?.includes(&#39;duplicate&#39;) &amp;&amp;
+             !error?.message?.includes(&#39;no such table&#39;)) {
+           console.warn(&#96;⚠️  执行SQL语句失败:&#96;, error?.message);
+           console.warn(&#96;SQL: ${statement.substring(0, 100)}...&#96;);
+         }
+       }
+     }
+   }
+ }
+

+     // 提取每个表的CREATE TABLE语句

+       }
+ 
+       console.log(&#96;📝 创建表 ${tableName}...&#96;);
+       
+       // 使用正则表达式提取CREATE TABLE语句
+       const createTableRegex = new RegExp(
+         &#96;CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ${tableName}[^;]+;&#96;,

+       );
+       const match = fullSchema.match(createTableRegex);
+       
+       if (match) {
```
